name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd
title: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd - 542011 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 revenue of INR 7,002 crore (+38%) and PAT INR 748 crore, but order book fell to INR 15,324 crore, with NGC (~INR 33,000 crore, L1) contract signing still pending and no revenue before FY28.
